questions.q: From which town did Jeremiah, of the priests, come?
questions.evidence: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin

questions.q: Where did Yahweh say he knew Jeremiah before he formed him?
questions.evidence: Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you

questions.q: Jeremiah protested that he was too young. What did he call himself?
questions.evidence: Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child

questions.q: What did Yahweh tell Jeremiah to buy and put on his waist?
questions.evidence: Yahweh says to me, “Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don’t put it in water

questions.q: To whose house was Jeremiah sent to watch the clay remade?
questions.evidence: Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words

questions.q: Who struck Jeremiah and put him in the stocks?
questions.evidence: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in Yahweh’s house

questions.q: After how many years for Babylon would Yahweh bring his people back?
questions.evidence: For Yahweh says, “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place

questions.q: Yahweh's thoughts toward his people are thoughts of what, to give them hope?
questions.evidence: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future

questions.q: What did Yahweh say he would make with the house of Israel and Judah?
questions.evidence: Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah

questions.q: Whose field did Jeremiah buy in Anathoth?
questions.evidence: I bought the field that was in Anathoth of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver

questions.q: Which king burned the first scroll of Jeremiah's words?
questions.evidence: Take again another scroll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah has burned

questions.q: Into what was Jeremiah let down with cords?
questions.evidence: They let down Jeremiah with cords. In the dungeon there was no water, but mire

questions.q: Which Ethiopian did the king send to take Jeremiah out of the dungeon?
questions.evidence: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, “Take from here thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he dies

questions.q: Who was the captain of the guard who burned Yahweh's house?
questions.evidence: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, who stood before the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem. He burned Yahweh’s house
